decisions.reason: The protection cap is a small accessory that builds on the firm's trailer coupling know-how and was given its own page in both observed years, but it sits further from the core trailer business than the other products, so the firm can judge and improve it less well.

The box car trailer series is close to the firm's core trailer engineering knowledge and was featured on the home page in 2018 and 2019, so the firm can readily read its market feedback and refine it.

The low-bed trailer series draws directly on the firm's existing trailer construction knowledge and was shown on the home page in both observed years, indicating it is a central product the firm can keep developing.

The high trailer cover series is a close extension of the firm's trailer lines and was prominent on the home page in both observed years, so the firm can learn from its results and improve it at low cost.
